project.name: aegis
project.description: Personal AI engineering team: LangGraph + Claude Agent SDK + MCP for solo developers

snapshot.head_subject: docs(status): mark phase 6 complete + Web dashboard section

phases.name: Core scaffolding
deliverables: core: config.py, task.py, worktree.py, lifecycle.py, budget.py

phases.name: Agent layer (Claude Agent SDK wrapper + prompts)
deliverables: agents/tools.py — MCP server wiring + signals merge
prompts: pm.md, dev.md, qa.md, reviewer.md, docs.md

phases.name: LangGraph team graph + CLI integration
deliverables: graph/team_graph.py — StateGraph with QA/Reviewer loops, interrupt_before=['docs']
CLI: run, status, stop, approve, reject, retry, inspect, daemon

phases.name: Observability (OTel + LangSmith + Langfuse + JSONL)
deliverables: obs/jsonl_exporter.py — custom OTel SpanExporter writing one JSON line per span to .aegis/trace/<task_id>.jsonl (UTF-8 byte-bounded truncation at 32KB)
obs/otel.py — bootstrap_tracing, TaskIdSpanProcessor, aegis_task_id_var contextvar (idempotent, thread-safe via double-checked lock)
obs/langfuse_exporter.py — Langfuse OTLP/HTTP exporter factory with Basic-auth
graph/runtime.py — root span (aegis.task / aegis.task.resume) + frontmatter trace_id persistence
graph/team_graph.py — per-node child spans via traced_node; interrupt_before only when checkpointer set
CLI: logs (tails JSONL trace), trace (opens LangSmith/Langfuse URL or hints aegis logs)
docker-compose.yml — Langfuse + Postgres + Redis self-host stack

phases.name: Web dashboard (read-only)
deliverables: web/app.py — FastAPI factory + middleware/CSRF/Jinja2 wiring (no global state)
web/middleware.py — OriginHostMiddleware (Host whitelist + Origin check on POST)
web/csrf.py — process-scoped CSRF token (constant-time compare, header-or-form)
web/render.py — markdown-it-py renderer (commonmark preset, html disabled, linkify enabled)
web/log_tail.py — JSONL trace tail reusing cli.commands.logs._format_line
web/git_diff.py — diff_stat / diff_full subprocess wrappers (256 KB cap)
cli/commands/web.py — uvicorn launcher (replaces stub; foreground only)

implemented.name: run
implemented.help: Run the team graph in the foreground (single task or drain backlog)

implemented.name: approve
implemented.help: Resume a task paused at the docs gate

implemented.name: reject
implemented.help: Discard a task paused at the docs gate

implemented.name: logs
implemented.help: Tail a task's JSONL trace (--follow polls every 250ms)

implemented.name: trace
implemented.help: Open a task's trace in LangSmith/Langfuse, or hint aegis logs

implemented.name: web
implemented.help: Start the read-only dashboard (foreground uvicorn, 127.0.0.1:8765 by default)

edges: qa -> dev (on rework verdict, loop-back limited)
graph_topology.human_gate: interrupt_before=['docs'] when a checkpointer is supplied — aegis approve resumes, aegis reject discards
graph_topology.completion_signals: in-process MCP server providing mcp__signals__done and mcp__signals__block, parsed by graph/parser.py

tool_allowlists.pm: project-index + fs read + signals (no fs writes)
tool_allowlists.dev: git read+write, fs read+write, shell, signals
tool_allowlists.qa: git read, fs read+write, shell, signals (no git writes — Dev owns commits)
tool_allowlists.reviewer: git read + project-index + signals (no git writes)
tool_allowlists.docs: fs read+write, git read + git_add + git_commit, signals (no branch/checkout/worktree/merge)

span_processors: TaskIdSpanProcessor — stamps aegis.task_id from contextvar on every span
BatchSpanProcessor(OTLPSpanExporter) — when observability.langfuse.enabled and keys present

observability.langsmith: parallel pipeline — env-var bootstrap (LANGCHAIN_TRACING_V2 + LANGCHAIN_PROJECT) so LangGraph's built-in callback handler ships traces
observability.langfuse: OTLP/HTTP at <url>/api/public/otel/v1/traces with Basic-auth from LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY/LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY
observability.jsonl_mirror: .aegis/trace/<task_id>.jsonl — UTF-8 byte-bounded (32KB), append-only, served by `aegis logs <id> [--follow]`
out_of_scope_for_phase_5: Per-MCP-tool child spans (would require per-subprocess OTel init + W3C context propagation across stdio)
Cost-per-span (requires threading `usage` data through the message stream into TeamState)

coverage_areas: graph (state, signals, parser, checkpointer, node_helpers, team_graph, runtime, nodes/*)
cli (main, init, task, config, run, status, stop, approve, reject, retry, inspect, daemon, logs, trace)
tests.local_run_status: 285 passed / 4 skipped excluding tests/unit/test_shell_mcp.py (pre-existing WSL env failures: missing `python` binary on PATH)

next_phase.scope: All originally-planned phases (1-6) complete. Items in `open_questions_deferred` remain candidates for follow-up phases.

open_questions_deferred: Multi-project daemon (initial: one project per daemon process)
File watcher vs poll-based backlog ingestion (currently poll on each loop)
Web templating choice (Jinja2+HTMX baseline; Starlette+HTMX+Tailwind CDN acceptable)
Per-MCP-tool child spans via stdio context propagation (deferred from Phase 5)
Cost-per-span capture (deferred from Phase 5; needs SDK usage data threaded into TeamState)
